title: agentd roster v1 — what Quickshell (and verify.sh) read
description: Raw strings only, never markup. Consumers must render text as plain text. Written atomically (tmp + os.replace) to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agentd/roster.json; rewritten only when content other than generatedAt changes. contracts/check_roster.py is the executable form of this document.

sessions.description: Sorted: waiting (oldest since first), then busy, then shell/idle/unknown (newest since first).

items.description: Revised in place 2026-11-14 (agentd and every reader ship together): `doing` became one line, `subagents` a list, `asked` and `waiting_on` joined. Readers normalise defensively, so a stale agentd still writing the old shapes degrades to empty values.

state.description: Claude Code's status, except that an idle or shell session whose own background work (run_in_background Bash or Agent, Monitor) has not reported back is busy, with waiting_on set: it goes on by itself.

doing.description: What it is doing, one high-level line: the open turn's **Ahora:** bullets (whole ones only, joined with ' · '), else the current tool's description, else the background work it waits on. Empty when unknown.

asked.description: The first sentence of the user's last typed prompt (origin human), cut at a word, one line; code, pastes, quotes and tags skipped. The only text of the user's own that agentd publishes. Empty when unknown.

did.description: Optional, additive (2026-11-14). The first line of the session's latest **Hecho:** block, whatever turn wrote it, cut at a word, credentials redacted, one line. Empty when it never wrote one. Readers must accept its absence.

waiting_on.description: Set only when state is busy because of pending background work: what it waits on (an agent first, then a shell, then a monitor).

subagents.description: From <session>/subagents/agent-<id>.meta.json: live ones first, then those finished in the last 10 minutes, newest first. Empty for an idle session.

live.description: No `finished` in its meta, written after the session's process started.

workspaces.description: The slots each output shows, in output order then id: slots 1..always_shown (constants.json) always, the rest only while occupied or active. A bar slot needs, per item: slot id = `id` (the key you press, 1..max_ws); monitor = `output` (Hyprland monitor name); focus = `active` (this output's active workspace; the focused one overall is hypr.focusedWorkspace); `occupied`; label = `label` (with any session here, the lead session's project, whichever window was focused last; else the folder, page or window title of the most recently focused window); icon key = `icon` ('claude' exactly when a session lives here, revised 2026-11-14; else the most recently focused window's kind); waiting = state == 'waiting'; working = state == 'busy'; title = sessions[sessionId == lead].title, else its name, else nothing (a slot without a lead has no title beyond its label). Slots missing from the list for an output are not shown there.

state.description: waiting if any session here waits, else busy if any works, else idle; null without sessions.

lead.description: Optional, additive (2026-11-09). sessionId of the most relevant session here: waiting > busy > shell/idle/unknown; ties go to the most recently focused window (the focused one while the workspace is active) and, inside it, to the session that names the window; then to the oldest `since`. Null exactly when state is null. Readers must accept its absence.
